lines: France, which prides itself as the global innovator of fashion, has decided its fashion industry has lost an absolute right to define physical beauty for women. Its lawmakers gave preliminary approval last week to a law that would make it a crime to employ ultra-thin models on runways. The parliament also agreed to ban websites that "incite excessive thinness" by promoting extreme dieting.
素以全球时尚开创者自居的法国已认定，其时尚产业已丧失为女性定义形体美的绝对权利。上周，法国立法者初步批准了一项法律，将把在T台上雇用极瘦模特定为犯罪。议会还同意封禁那些通过鼓吹极端节食来“煽动过度瘦身材”的网站。

lines: Such measures have a couple of uplifting motives. They suggest beauty should not be defined by looks that end up impinging on health. That's a start. And the ban on ultra-thin models seems to go beyond protecting models from starving themselves to death - as some have done. It tells the fashion industry that it must take responsibility for the signal it sends women, especially teenage girls, about the social tape-measure they must use to determine their individual worth.
这些措施有几个令人振奋的动机。它们表明，美不应以那些最终损害健康的外貌标准来定义。这是一个开端。而对极瘦模特的禁令，似乎还不止于保护模特免于把自己饿死——确有一些模特如此。它向时尚业表明，必须为其向女性、尤其是少女发出的信号负责，因为那关乎她们该用怎样的社会尺度来衡量自身价值。

lines: The bans, if fully enforced, would suggest to women (and many men) that they should not let others be arbiters of their beauty. lines: The French measures, however, rely too much on severe punishment to change a culture that still regards beauty as skin-deep - and bone-showing. lines: In contrast to France's actions, Denmark's fashion industry agreed last month on rules and sanctions regarding the age, health, and other characteristics of models. The newly revised Danish Fashion Ethical Charter clearly states: "We are aware of and take responsibility for the impact the fashion industry has on body ideals, especially on young people." The charter's main tool of enforcement is to deny access for designers and modeling agencies to Copenhagen Fashion Week (CFW), which is run by the Danish Fashion Institute. But in general it relies on a name-and-shame method of compliance.
与法国的做法不同，丹麦时尚业上个月就模特的年龄、健康状况等特征达成了一系列规则与制裁措施。新修订的《丹麦时尚道德宪章》明确写道：“我们意识到时尚业对身材理想观的影响，尤其是对年轻人的影响，并为此承担责任。”该宪章主要的执行手段，是禁止设计师和模特经纪公司参加由丹麦时装研究院主办的哥本哈根时装周（CFW）。但总体而言，它依靠的是“点名曝光、以耻促改”的约束方式。

lines: For the first time in history more people live in towns than in the country. In Britain this has had a curious result. While polls show Britons rate "the countryside" alongside the royal family, Shakespeare and the National Health Service (NHS) as what makes them proudest of their country, this has limited political support.

lines: A century ago Octavia Hill launched the National Trust not to rescue stylish houses but to save "the beauty of natural places for everyone forever." It was specifically to provide city dwellers with spaces for leisure where they could experience "a refreshing air." Hill's pressure later led to the creation of national parks and green belts. They don't make countryside any more, and every year concrete consumes more of it. It needs constant guardianship.

lines: At the next election none of the big parties seem likely to endorse this sentiment. lines: The idea that "housing crisis" equals "concreted meadows" is pure lobby talk. The issue is not the need for more houses but, as always, where to put them. Under lobby pressure, George Osborne favours rural new-build against urban renovation and renewal. He favours out-of-town shopping sites against high streets. This is not a free market but a biased one. Rural towns and villages have grown and will always grow. They do so best where building sticks to their edges and respects their character. We do not ruin urban conservation areas. Why ruin rural ones? Development should be planned, not let rip. After the Netherlands, Britain is Europe's most crowded country. Half a century of town and country planning has enabled it to retain an enviable rural coherence, while still permitting low-density urban living. There is no doubt of the alternative - the corrupted landscapes of southern Portugal, Spain or Ireland. Avoiding this rather than promoting it should unite the left and right of the political spectrum.

lines: "There is one and only one social responsibility of business," wrote Milton Friedman, a Nobel prize-winning economist, "That is, to use its resources and engage in activities designed to increase its profits." But even if you accept Friedman's premise and regard corporate social responsibility (CSR) policies as a waste of shareholders' money, things may not be absolutely clear-cut. New research suggests that CSR may create monetary value for companies - at least when they are prosecuted for corruption.
诺贝尔经济学奖得主米尔顿·弗里德曼写道：“企业有且只有一项社会责任，那就是运用其资源、从事旨在增加其利润的活动。”但即便你接受弗里德曼的前提，把企业社会责任（CSR）政策视为对股东金钱的浪费，事情也未必那么绝对分明。新研究表明，CSR可能为企业创造货币价值——至少当它们因腐败被起诉时是如此。

lines: The largest firms in America and Britain together spend more than $15 billion a year on CSR, according to an estimate by EPG, a consulting firm. This could add value to their businesses in three ways. First, consumers may take CSR spending as a "signal" that a company's products are of high quality. Second, customers may be willing to buy a company's products as an indirect way to donate to the good causes it helps. And third, through a more diffuse "halo effect," whereby its good deeds earn it greater consideration from consumers and others.
据咨询公司EPG估计，美英两国最大的企业每年在CSR上的支出合计超过150亿美元。这可能通过三种途径为其业务增加价值。第一，消费者可能把CSR支出当作企业产品高质量的“信号”。第二，顾客可能愿意购买该公司的产品，以此作为向其所赞助的公益事业间接捐款的方式。第三，通过一种更为弥散的“光环效应”，企业的善行能为其赢得消费者和其他方面更多的体谅。

lines: Previous studies on CSR have had trouble differentiating these effects because consumers can be affected by all three. lines: The study found that, among prosecuted firms, those with the most comprehensive CSR programmes tended to get more lenient penalties. lines: In all, the study concludes that whereas prosecutors should only evaluate a case based on its merits, they do seem to be influenced by a company's record in CSR. lines: The difference between today's workplace and the "dress for success" era is that the range of options is so much broader. Norms have evolved and fragmented. In some settings, red sneakers or dress T-shirts can convey status; in others not so much. Plus, whatever image we present is magnified by social-media services like LinkedIn. Chances are, your headshots are seen much more often now than a decade or two ago. Millennials, it seems, face the paradox of being the least formal generation yet the most conscious of style and personal branding. It can be confusing.
如今的职场与“为成功而穿”的时代不同之处在于，选择的范围要宽广得多。规范已经演变并趋于碎片化。在某些场合，红色运动鞋或西式T恤能彰显地位；在另一些场合则未必。此外，我们呈现的任何形象都会被LinkedIn等社交媒体放大。很可能，你的头像如今被看到的频率远高于一二十年前。千禧一代似乎面临着一个悖论：他们是最不拘形式的一代，却也是最在意风格和个人品牌的一代。这确实令人困惑。

lines: 41. As an executive coach, I've seen image upgrades be particularly helpful during transitions - when looking for a new job, stepping into a new or more public role, or changing work environments. If you're in a period of change or just feeling stuck and in a rut, now may be a good time. If you're not sure, ask for honest feedback from trusted friends, colleagues and professionals. Look for cues about how others perceive you. Maybe there's no need for an upgrade and that's OK.
41. 作为一名高管教练，我发现形象提升在人生转折期尤其有用——比如找新工作时、走上新的或更公开的角色时，或是更换工作环境时。如果你正处于变动期，或者只是感到停滞不前、墨守成规，现在也许正是好时机。如果你拿不准，可以向信任的朋友、同事和专业人士寻求坦诚的反馈。寻找他人如何看待你的线索。也许根本不需要升级形象，那也没什么不好。

lines: 42. Get clear on what impact you're hoping to have. Are you looking to refresh your image or pivot it? For one person, the goal may be to be taken more seriously and enhance their professional image. For another, it may be to be perceived as more approachable, or more modern and stylish. For someone moving from finance to advertising, maybe they want to look more "SoHo." (It's OK to use characterizations like that.)
42. 想清楚你希望达到怎样的效果。你是想刷新形象，还是彻底转向？对有些人来说，目标可能是让自己更显分量、提升职业形象。对另一些人来说，则可能是显得更亲和，或更时髦、更有型。对一个正从金融业转向广告业的人来说，也许他想看起来更有“soho范儿”。（用这类标签描述是可以的。）

lines: Mental health is the seed that contains self-esteem - confidence in ourselves and an ability to trust in our common sense. It allows us to have perspective on our lives - the ability to not take ourselves too seriously, to laugh at ourselves, to see the bigger picture, and to see that things will work out. It's a form of innate or unlearned optimism. (48) Mental health allows us to view others with sympathy if they are having troubles, with kindness if they are in pain, and with unconditional love no matter who they are. Mental health is the source of creativity for solving problems, resolving conflict, making our surroundings more beautiful, managing our home life, or coming up with a creative business idea or invention to make our lives easier. It gives us patience for ourselves and toward others as well as patience while driving, catching a fish, working on our car, or raising a child. It allows us to see the beauty that surrounds us each moment in nature, in culture, in the flow of our daily lives.

心理健康是一颗包含自尊的种子——即对我们的自信，以及对自身常识的信任。它让我们能够以长远的目光看待自己的生活——能够不过分苛责自己，能够自嘲，能够看到更大的格局，并且相信事情终会好转。它是一种天生的、无需习得的乐观。(48) 心理健康使我们能够同情身陷困境之人，善待遭受痛苦之人，并且无论对方是谁都报以无条件的爱。心理健康是创造力的源泉，让我们得以解决问题、化解冲突、美化环境、打理家庭生活，或者想出让生活更轻松的创意商业点子或发明。它让我们对自己、对他人抱有耐心，也在开车、钓鱼、修车或养育孩子时保持耐心。它使我们能够随时看到周遭的美——在自然中，在文化中，在日常生活的流转之中。

sentences.zh: 习惯性玩手游的父亲树立了一个无声的榜样；多年之后，孩子把这种习惯内化于心，又以同样的方式对待自己的父母。

sentences.en: Words of instruction are easily forgotten, but patterns of behavior are quietly passed on.
sentences.zh: 训诫之词易被遗忘，行为模式却在悄然传承。

sample: Therefore, to educate children, parents should first educate themselves. Rather than merely telling children what to do, they should demonstrate the values they wish to instill - reading instead of browsing, communicating instead of staring at screens. Only through setting a good example by their own conduct can parents truly guide the next generation, for actions speak louder than words.
因此，要教育孩子，父母应先教育自己。与其只是告诉孩子该做什么，不如亲身示范自己希望传递的价值观——以阅读代替刷屏，以交流代替凝视屏幕。父母唯有以身作则，才能真正引导下一代，因为身教胜于言传。
